summary: Allstate's outage is in its fifth day and the company still has not said why. New: software maker SAP says hackers broke into its systems. A Wyoming uranium plant also remains shut after a cyber incident on Nov 20. No official source links these events.

events.title: Allstate nationwide website, app and phone outage, now in its fifth day
events.impact: Customers and agents have trouble reaching policies, paying bills or filing claims online. Allstate says no one will lose coverage or pay late fees. No restoration time has been given.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Allstate has not given a cause. Online talk about AI or layoffs has no support.

events.title: SAP says hackers broke into its systems
events.impact: SAP says hackers may have reached its source code through stolen GitHub keys. It says it has no evidence customer business data was touched.
events.stated_cause: SAP calls it an active security incident. Who did it is unknown. I saw only one article, which cites Der Spiegel and SAP's own statement.

events.title: Wyoming uranium plant still shut after cyber incident
events.impact: Peninsula Energy shut its Lance plant after plant and wellfield control systems were hit. Office systems in the US and Australia are said to be unaffected. No restart date. Its shares stay suspended until Nov 30 at the latest.
events.stated_cause: The company calls it a cybersecurity incident found on Nov 20. It has not said who did it or how. It told US authorities and is checking for data theft.

events.title: South African investing app EasyEquities locked out customers after cyberattack
events.impact: Customers were locked out of the platform. The company has not said what was affected or when it will be back. This is outside the US.
events.stated_cause: The company emailed customers about a cyberattack. It gave no details. It had just rolled out a new app design, and some people suspect that.

events.title: FBI investigating break-in at its national crime database
events.impact: Police use this database for warrant checks and stolen property records. It is unclear what was taken or whether police lost access. No new details this run.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Reports rely on unnamed sources and the FBI has not commented publicly.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation software was disrupted. As of Nov 24, USDA had not said if all is back or if financial data was taken. No newer update found.
events.stated_cause: A USDA official said systems were shut down over a cyber threat and no personal data was lost. No attacker has been named.

events.title: Thanksgiving storm cut power to more than 850,000 customers
events.impact: Virginia, Maryland and Pennsylvania were hit hardest. More than 420 US flights were canceled and about 2,000 delayed. The FAA paused flights into Washington National for thunderstorms. The FAA airport feed now shows only routine closures.
events.stated_cause: Weather. The National Weather Service reported 50 to 70 mph wind gusts along the East Coast.

events.title: Tanker attacks in Strait of Hormuz and Houthi strikes on Saudi sites keep oil near month high
events.impact: Brent crude is about 96 dollars a barrel, its highest settle since Nov 6. A Saudi Jazan refinery strike reportedly killed one worker. Shipping costs are up.
events.stated_cause: Iran says mines hit ships. The Houthis claimed the Saudi refinery attacks. The Hormuz claims are not independently confirmed.

events.title: Bitcoin steady near 61K USD after a dip; no crash found
events.impact: CoinMarketCap 60,880 (+3.4% day). CoinGecko 61,624 (+1.9% day, -0.3% week). TradingView 60,538. Prices agree. No exchange outage found. Claims of a crypto crash do not match the data.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Reports cite tariff and inflation worries, and a House bill for a Bitcoin reserve.

events.title: Mid-November outages (Microsoft, FAA, banks): causes explained, no attack reported
events.impact: Microsoft 365 was down nearly 24 hours. An FAA ground stop and bank problems followed. All are back. New: Microsoft's early report and an analyst say these were separate.
events.stated_cause: Microsoft traces its outage to a July change on Exchange servers and says no cyberattack caused it. The DNI said they were separate outages. Some online outlets still claim an attack.

events.title: CISA adds 10 actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers Danfoss, HPE Juniper, Mitel and Vates products. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not link the flaws to any incident above.

events.title: Cloudflare status page still shows reduced performance on Sites and Services
events.impact: Status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed Nov 26 at 18:17 UTC. I found no news report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: Allstate has not said what broke. The uranium plant and SAP both call theirs cyber incidents, but nobody has named an attacker or method. The storm outages are weather, and Microsoft's outage was tied to a software change. No official source reports a cyber attack across these events or links them.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment with the same symptoms.

alert.reason: No official link between incidents and no sign of widespread failure. Cyber incidents at Wyoming uranium plant and SAP are separate and contained so far.

prep_note: Allstate customers: keep policy numbers handy, try phone or a local agent, and save records of any payment attempts. Everyone: use strong passwords and turn on two-step sign-in. If you travel after the storm, check your flight status before leaving.
